changelog: Spoken punctuation now understands parentheses and square brackets: say "open parenthesis" / "close parenthesis" (or "প্রথম বন্ধনী শুরু" / "প্রথম বন্ধনী শেষ" in Bengali) and ( ) appear around your words — handy for asides and dates in a dictated message. Say "open bracket" / "close bracket" (or "তৃতীয় বন্ধনী শুরু" / "তৃতীয় বন্ধনী শেষ") for [ ]. Works in the app and in the voice keyboard, only when the spoken-punctuation setting is on.
